name: Timed online consignment auctions for small business closings (restaurant, light-industrial, office) in Cook and collar counties
summary: Licensed Illinois auction firm (founder becomes licensed auctioneer and managing auctioneer) running on-site-catalogued, timed online auctions on HiBid for $5k-$50k closings that large liquidators skip. Revenue per sale = buyer's premium + seller commission on hammer. Each sale is modelled as a one-time 'customer'; repeat/referral flow from trustees, landlords, lenders and dealers is the referral driver. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Licence path is official: online auctions are licensed activity from 2026-01-01 (P.A. 104-0145; C, C9-S032; A, C9-S029); individual licence $200 + PSI exam; firm $100 + licensed managing auctioneer (A, C9-S030). Exemption conditions for online auctions MISSING (ILGA unreachable).
Competition is rising: IDFPR data show 137 new individual auctioneer licences and 34 new firm licences issued in 2026 YTD vs 23-49 and 8-14 per year in 2019-2024 (A, DH-S003).

Platform cost is published: HiBid 2% auction fee + $0.25/unique bid capped at $150/auction; AuctionFlex 360 Solo $95/month (B, DH-S007). LiveAuctioneers timed: $25-275/event + 5% commission (B, DH-S008).

Take rates: RestaurantEquipment.Bid (TAGeX) charges 15% buyer's premium and serves Chicago closings (B, DH-S010); Illinois HiBid listings show 10-23% premiums (B, DH-S011); incumbent Liquidity Services earns 9.8% (GovDeals) to 18.6% (CAG) of GMV (A, C9-S033). Seller commission on small sales (10% base) is E.

Supply: ~880 Chicago restaurants per year are recorded 'Out of Business' at inspection (883 in 2025; A, DH-S001); N.D. Ill. business bankruptcies 789 in the 12 months to 2026-06-30, of which 558 Chapter 7 (A, DH-S006); 25 Chapter 7 panel trustees (A, DH-S004).
Hammer per sale ($18k base) and all funnel drivers are E: no completed small-operator sale results were retrievable (HiBid/CourtListener sold-price data blocked).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Exam + $200 licence application + $100 firm registration + special (escrow) account (A, C9-S030); timing E (1-3 months for licence, plus insurance, HiBid/AuctionFlex setup).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Lease-end closings force quick decisions; comparable restaurant liquidation ran ~2 weeks of bidding (D, keyauctioneers case study, Stage D search).
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Referral relationships (trustees, landlords, dealers, brokers) take quarters to produce flow.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified consignment inquiries. Supply pool ~880 Chicago restaurant closures/yr (A, DH-S001) + 558 N.D. Ill. business Ch.7 cases/yr (A, DH-S006) + suburban/industrial closures (unmeasured).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Competes with dealers buying outright, TAGeX/RestaurantEquipment.Bid, Facebook Marketplace and licensed local firms.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Second licensed auction manager / business developer from month 25.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Repeat consignments from trustees/lenders/landlords plus seller referrals per 100 relationship records per month.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Relationship decay: most closing-business sellers never repeat.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: No recurring revenue; all revenue is per sale.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Hammer x (buyer's premium + seller commission): $10k x 22% / $18k x 25% (15% BP, B DH-S010 + 10% commission E) / $30k x 27%. Incumbent take 9.8-18.6% of GMV (A, C9-S033).
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Per-sale direct costs on $18k hammer: HiBid 2% + bid fees ~$510 (B, DH-S007), absorbed card fees ~$310, load-out crew ~$500, ads/supplies/van ~$270 = ~$1,590 of $4,500 (65%). Liquidity Services consignment segment direct profit 85-95% of revenue is incumbent scale (A, C9-S033).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Site visits, valuation time, referral-partner meetings (no referral fees assumed; legality of paying unlicensed referrers to be confirmed).
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, buyer-list email, TMA Chicago/Midwest and IRA events.
drivers.dso_days__source: Buyers pay before pickup (RestaurantEquipment.Bid terms, B DH-S010); premium and commission withheld from proceeds held in special account (A, C9-S030).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Platform invoices and crew paid within ~2 weeks.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Licence, kit, trailer, insurance and first-year operating losses.

transactions.name: T1 - Closing 60-seat full-service restaurant, Chicago (lease ending), ~180 lots, $18,000 hammer
transactions.notes: Revenue = 15% buyer's premium ($2,700) + 10% seller commission ($1,800). Contribution ~$2,910 (65%). Buyers pay within 2-3 days of close; seller remitted from special account within ~10-14 days.

transactions.name: T2 - Trustee-retained Chapter 7 sale of a small machine shop (court-approved), $40,000 hammer
transactions.notes: Buyer's premium 15% only ($6,000); trustees often negotiate low/no seller commission (E). Compensation subject to court approval; USTP requires auctioneer bonding (A, DH-S005). Contribution ~$3,200 (53%). Payment lag: court order on report of sale.

transactions.name: T3 - Small office relocation (furniture, IT, break-room), Schaumburg, $6,000 hammer
transactions.notes: 15% BP + 10% commission. Contribution ~$645 (43%) - small sales barely cover founder time; minimum fee policy needed.
